messages.subject: User screenshot capture - integrating javascript?
parts:
Hi guys, my friend who has no access to Google Groups has a question about Rshiny. Can anyone help her? Thanks.

My project team is working on an app in Rshiny right now. We are wondering if it's possible to create a button that will let the users take a screenshot of the website and send the image to the server. So far I haven't seen anything related to this in Rshinytutorials. I did find some potential way to create this button, namely by designing a input widget using javascript with the help of the information from the following two websites:

http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#building-inputs
http://www.kubilayerdogan.net/?p=304

I haven't learned javascript yet so I am not exactly sure if it's feasible. Do you have any idea about this or would you have a better way to do this?

Thank you so much!
